description: Creates a project. Returns 403 when the plan limit is reached (1 on Free, 3 on Pro, 20 on Team) — monitors and status pages are counted per account, so a new project does not raise those limits. A new project starts with every notification channel switched OFF: monitoring notifications go nowhere until `project_channel_set` enables them. That is deliberate — a project is usually created for a new client, and channels enabled by default would send their alerts into somebody else’s chat.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name.description: Shown in the panel, in weekly report emails and on the public weekly report page (only when the account has more than one project).

name: project_create
title: Create project
